summary: HUB Cyber Security Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an 8-K current report) disclosing the board appointment of Richard Paolone and Joseph Tung as independent directors effective October 13, 2026. No stake, price, premium or transaction terms were stated. Compensation follows shareholder-approved director terms, with customary indemnification agreements expected. The press release references ongoing comprehensive restructuring and exploration of strategic alternatives, but this filing itself is a governance event—not a special situation—with no advisor, break fee, regulatory clock or deal terms disclosed. Watch for subsequent filings on the restructuring and strategic-alternatives process rather than treating this appointment as a standalone catalyst.
